The '''Bed''' is a piece of [[furniture]]. It can be purchased at the [[Carpenter's Shop]] for {{Price|500}}.

It's also available from the [[Furniture Catalogue]] for {{Price|0}}.

This Bed is automatically placed inside the [[Farmhouse]] at the start of the game no matter what [[Farm Maps|farm map]] is selected. It is automatically changed into a [[Double Bed]] when the house is [[Farmhouse#Upgrades|upgraded]] for the first time.
